subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` fail closed whenever active-model provider metadata is missing?
rationale: The strict gate is the safest provider-billing boundary, but it changes existing unknown-provider behavior and the linked canonical issue explicitly left the policy choice to maintainers.

options.title: Accept strict provider gating
options.body: Require positive `activeModel.provider === "xai"` before exposing xAI-billed tools, then land with docs, factory tests, and real multi-provider proof.

options.title: Keep unknown-provider compatibility behind opt-in
options.body: Preserve legacy unknown-provider exposure only through an explicit maintainer-approved config or tool-policy opt-in so default behavior still prevents surprising billing.

options.title: Pause for broader billed-tool policy
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers define a cross-provider billed-tool policy covering explicit opt-in, warnings, and cost attribution across providers.

recommendation.title: Accept strict provider gating
recommendation.body: Require positive `activeModel.provider === "xai"` before exposing xAI-billed tools, then land with docs, factory tests, and real multi-provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to both the current xAI plugin entrypoint and the plugin tool context boundary that would enforce the decision.
